CONTROLLER XBOX
REM Xbox full input test: every button, the d-pad and both sticks
REM Open a gamepad tester first. Each input is pressed once, 400 ms apart.
DELAY 2000

PRESS A
DELAY 400

DELAY 400
PRESS X
DELAY 400

DELAY 400

DELAY 400

DELAY 400

DELAY 400

DELAY 400

DELAY 400

DELAY 400

DELAY 400

REM ---- Both sticks at once ----

DELAY 400
HOLD LS_LEFT RS_RIGHT 800
DELAY 400

REM ---- System buttons (last: XBOX opens the guide overlay, so it comes last) ----
